Hi Markus / Laura —

Following up from last week's 1:1s: hiring momentum is real for the inference runtime team and I want to get permission to open a Senior Inference Engineer requisition (IC, individual contributor) to both backfill a departing engineer and add headroom for Q1 work. Attached: JD_SeniorInference_V2.pdf and a proposed interview slate (quick panel + system design + pair-coding).

What I need today:
- Formal OK to open the req (we're tight on runway but have budget headroom in infra hiring).
- Confirmation of comp band (range pref) so Talent can market appropriately.
- Interview panel sign-offs and availability constraints (targeting first round wk of Jan 4).

Candidate sourcing plan: TalentBridge (external recruiting partner) has a warm slate; Samyra is scoped to provide an initial 6-person shortlist. I'll attach the slate once I have the greenlight to post.

Attachments: JD_SeniorInference_V2.pdf (draft), interview_panel_agenda.docx (proposed panel + question map)

Thanks — aiming to move fast on this one.

— Priyom

Priyom —

Quick yes on opening the req. Two asks before we post:
1) Please confirm expected comp band (L4/L5 equivalent) and the target base + equity zone so people on the panel give consistent feedback.
2) Can you make sure the slate includes one product-side interviewer (to focus on tradeoffs) and one infra/reliability interviewer (to focus on latency/cost optimizations)?

Laura — if you have any objections to the panel configuration or the JD (I had a few wording nits) speak up. Marissa, please put this on the hiring calendar if Markus and Laura are fine.

If nothing else, approve and Priyom can instruct TalentBridge to proceed.

— Markus

Thanks — I reviewed the JD and panel doc. A few notes:
- Edit the JD to emphasize "production inference experience" (latency SLOs, KV-caching, batching).
- Prefer target comp band at L5; we've historically hired similar roles at the higher band to reduce churn.
- Scheduling constraints: I will be OOO Dec 21–31; earliest interview week I can do is Jan 4. Markus is available Jan 4–8 except Tues afternoon.

Samyra (TalentBridge) — please go ahead and run the search if we approve the posting language; attach the initial slate CSV so we can calibrate for matching.

Priyom — can you add a short calibration 30-min session for the interview panel (rubric + sample answers) prior to interviews? That helped last hiring cycle.

Attachments: candidate_slate_talentbridge.csv
